news.title: Cunningham scores 26, Collins has double-double in Detroit's 106-93 win over LeBron, 76ers
news.text: — Cade Cunningham scored 26 points, and John Collins had 16 points and 11 rebounds to help the Detroit Pistons stay unbeaten with a 106-93 win over LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday night.

news.title: Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management
news.text: Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.

news.title: Joel Embiid posts triple-double as LeBron-less Sixers stay unbeaten
news.text: Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points, and the 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Bucks.

news.title: Embiid posts triple-double with LeBron out to keep 76ers perfect in 127-116 win over Bucks
news.text: — Joel Embiid had a triple-double with LeBron James out, Jaylen Brown scored 27 points on his 30th birthday and the Philadelphia 76ers remained undefeated with a 127-116 win over the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday night.

news.title: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
news.text: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.
